title: Madam Spider's Web
author: Sara Dee
description:
Madam Spider sits in her rocking chair, with two eyes on the knitting in her lap and the other six on you. She sighs deeply.

"The house is in a disarray yet again-- it could really use some tidying up, particularly the bathroom and the music room." You nod, trying not to fidget under her stern gaze.

"The last girl couldn't keep things straight either," Madam Spider continues. "She turned out to be quite delicious."
